review.notes:
FIX 1.2.6 (Guideline 4 - Design): all system permission requests (location, camera, microphone) are now localized in English, Russian and Uzbek and always appear in the same language as the app; the base language is English. The app interface also starts in the device language.

1) SCREEN RECORDING (iPhone, latest iOS, current build): https://spesmuz.github.io/uno-menu/appstore/review.mp4 (starts from the Home Screen: menu, dish card with reviews and the Report/Block menu, cart and delivery form, UNO AI chat, booking, about and profile).

2) PURPOSE AND AUDIENCE: UNO Airways is the official app of one restaurant, UNO Airways Restaurante in Fergana, Uzbekistan (aviation-themed, Turkish and European cuisine, 350 seats). It is for the restaurant's guests: browse the live menu with photos, videos, prices and calories; order delivery; book a table; get help choosing a dish; read restaurant news. It replaces paper menus and phone calls.

3) HOW TO USE - no account, no login, no payment inside the app:
- Menu tab: swipe dishes, switch categories, change language (UZ/RU/EN), open a dish card for details and reviews. Add dishes to the cart; Cart > Delivery sends the order (name, phone, address, optional location) to the restaurant; payment is cash or card to the courier.
- UNO AI button (gold, bottom-left of the menu): a chat assistant that only recommends dishes from this menu and answers questions about the restaurant. Tapping a suggested dish shows it in the menu. It cannot change anything.
- Book tab: date, time, guests, hall; the restaurant confirms by phone (24/7: +998 91 881 69 79).
- UNO tab: about the restaurant, call, map, Instagram.
- Profile tab: optional name, phone and photo, used only to pre-fill forms; restaurant news.

4) EXTERNAL SERVICES: Supabase (database and storage for menu, orders, bookings), Google Gemini API (UNO AI chat; called from our server, the key is never on the device), Telegram Bot API (order and booking notifications to restaurant staff), Apple Maps/Google Maps/Yandex Maps links. No ads, no analytics, no tracking, no in-app purchases.

5) USER-GENERATED CONTENT: guests can rate dishes and leave short reviews. Every review has a "..." button with Report (the restaurant is notified at once; 3 reports hide it automatically) and Block author (hides all reviews of that author on the device). Staff moderate and delete reviews in the restaurant's admin panel.

6) REGIONS: the app works the same in all regions; content is about one restaurant in Uzbekistan. Not a regulated industry; all menu photos and texts belong to the restaurant.

en-US.subtitle: Menu, booking & delivery
en-US.description:
Welcome aboard UNO Airways Restaurante — an aviation-themed restaurant in the heart of Fergana, serving Turkish and European cuisine.

With the app you can:
• Browse the full menu with photos, short videos, prices and calories
• See ratings from other guests and leave your own review
• Order delivery across Fergana — add dishes to the cart, share your address or location, pay in cash or by card to the courier
• Book a table for a family dinner, business lunch, birthday, wedding or conference — choose the date, time, number of guests and the hall (family, comfort, business, terrace, VIP)
• Get a reminder two hours before your booking
• Save your name, phone and photo once in your profile — they are filled in automatically everywhere
• Follow restaurant news: live music every evening, shows and concerts

Our waiters wear pilot uniforms, a large airplane model flies over the building and the hall is full of trees and living plants. The restaurant seats 350 guests.

Address: Fergana, Sohibqiron Temur street, 30
Phone (24/7): +998 91 881 69 79
Instagram: @uno_airways_restaurante
en-US.promotionalText: Live music every evening. Book a table or order delivery in a few taps.

ru.subtitle: Меню, бронь и доставка
ru.description:
Добро пожаловать на борт UNO Airways Restaurante — ресторана в авиационном стиле в самом центре Ферганы. Турецкая и европейская кухня.

В приложении вы можете:
• Смотреть всё меню с фото, короткими видео, ценами и калорийностью
• Видеть оценки других гостей и оставлять свой отзыв
• Заказывать доставку по Фергане — добавьте блюда в корзину, укажите адрес или точку на карте, оплатите наличными или картой курьеру
• Бронировать столик на семейный ужин, бизнес-ланч, день рождения, свадьбу или конференцию — выберите дату, время, число гостей и зал (семейный, комфорт, бизнес, терраса, VIP)
• Получать напоминание за два часа до брони
• Один раз сохранить имя, телефон и фото в профиле — они подставятся сами
• Следить за новостями ресторана: живая музыка каждый вечер, шоу и концерты

Наши официанты в форме пилотов, над зданием парит большой макет самолёта, а в зале много деревьев и живых растений. Ресторан рассчитан на 350 гостей.

Адрес: Фергана, ул. Сохибкирон Темур, 30
Телефон (24/7): +998 91 881 69 79
Instagram: @uno_airways_restaurante
ru.promotionalText: Живая музыка каждый вечер. Бронируйте столик или заказывайте доставку в пару касаний.
